title: Board resolution
description: Certified true copy of a resolution of the board of directors (default wording: opening and operating bank accounts), with the authorised directors and the certification block.

params.title: BOARD RESOLUTION
params.preamble: CERTIFIED TRUE COPY OF THE EXTRACT FROM THE MINUTES OF THE MEETING OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF {companyUpper} HELD AT {addressUpper} ON {date}

resolutions.text: THAT a current account and a merchant account (for card and online payments) be opened in the name of {companyUpper}, {address}, with {bank}.
THAT the following directors of the Company be and are hereby authorised, singly or jointly, to sign the documents required to open the said accounts and to operate the said accounts:

THAT the following directors of the Company be and are hereby authorised, singly or jointly, to execute on behalf of the Company all documents required by {bank} in connection with the said current account and merchant account:
THAT a certified true copy of this resolution be furnished to {bank}, which may act on it until it receives written notice of any change from the Company.

fields.name: address
fields.label: Place of the meeting
fields.help: Address printed in the preamble and the resolution (default: the brand's registered address)

fields.name: directors
fields.label: Directors
fields.help: [{ name, role }]: the directors authorised by the resolution

fields.name: certifiers
fields.label: Certifying directors
fields.help: Names of the directors who sign the certification (default: the first two)

fields.name: resolutions
fields.label: Resolutions
fields.help: Replaces params.resolutions: [{ text, directors? }]; directors: true lists the directors after the paragraph
